title: rayx 1.0.0: the new RayX CLI for NSH apps, with the machine side ported, nsh managed per project, and fork releases

checks.descriptionMarkdown: Groups `package_layout`, `cli_surface` (new) and `dependency_sources` (ported), `library_guard` (new, D14).
Ported, adapted groups for `dist-workspace.toml`, `release-plz.toml`, the workflows and `docs/releasing.md`.
No duplicate keys or YAML errors in the workflows (AgentX's checker).
Ported host groups.
Ported engine groups, with the no-GPU-set tests added to `setup_engine`.
Ported discovery, pins (design §7 table) and fmt groups.
`setup_macos` (ported), `setup_linux` (rewritten for NSH), `setup_windows` (adapted: no fxc, WebView2).
`setup_web` rewritten: no nightly, wasm-bindgen only with a lock entry.
Ported test-set groups plus the Chromium path.
`setup_ios` adapted: no XcodeGen, the Catalyst target.
Android groups adapted for NSH (35, build-tools, targets, no cargo-ndk).
The ported guest groups, with the GPU step gone and `.nsh/` in `compact --clean`.
`doctor` ported, without the GPU section.
Ported self-update and release groups for the new repository and the 1.0.0 floor.
AgentX's memory audit over `.agentx/memory`: no errors (a clean audit prints `[OK]`, one with only warnings a `Summary: 0 error(s)` line).

`fork-release.yml` parses without duplicate keys, and its parsed triggers, the five platforms, the non-blocking `windows-arm64`, the Android-free `linux-arm64`, the required archives, the published release and the absence of installers match FORK-1.
TAP script for the release-workflow warning of `sync-main.sh upstream` (a range that changes `release.yml` and one that does not) and `sync-main.sh branch` (a change reaching a topic branch).
New group: lock sources, discovery, `rayx.toml`, both, neither, the default.
New group: layout, receipts, unfinished entries, the lock, prune.
New group: archive names and URLs, digests, unpacking, fallback, the source commands, the CLI check.
New group for `rayx nsh status|path|install`.
New group: the base-set step, `--check`, `--update`, doctor's lines and JSON.
Ignored group: real installs of upstream `v0.2.0` (release) and `fork-0.2.0-4` (source) into a temporary `RAYX_HOME`, and the crate list against the fork.
New group: arguments, directory, environment, exec and exit codes.
New group: the §6.1 map, silent installs, refusals, `--no-install`, `--browser`.
New group: `RAYX_NSH` and path pins.
New group: each template, the patches, the lock, `rayx.toml`, refusals.
New group against a running server on a free port.
Ignored group: a `rayx new` app built, run, tested and packaged on the web.
Ignored group: the same app's tests on macOS and the iOS simulator.
Ignored group: rayx in Gamify's `src/frontend`, read only.
Ported README groups and the new `readme_nsh`.
`cargo fmt --check` for the package.
`cargo clippy --all-targets -- -D warnings`, as CI runs it.
`cargo build --release --locked`: the binary cargo-dist will package builds from the committed lock.

tasks.title: The package, the CLI surface and the guards
tasks.descriptionMarkdown: Create `Cargo.toml` (REPO-1), `rust-toolchain.toml`, `src/lib.rs` with `run()`, `src/main.rs`, and `src/cli.rs` with the ten top-level commands (later sprints add their options; until then a command prints that it is not available yet and exits 1). Port `tests/package_layout.rs` and `tests/dependency_sources.rs` from the old CLI, write `tests/cli_surface.rs` for the top level and `tests/library_guard.rs` for D14 with failing fixtures, and `tests/common/mod.rs` (the old `Workspace` helper).

tasks.title: CI and release configuration
tasks.descriptionMarkdown: Port and adapt `.github/workflows/ci.yml`, `release-plz.yml` and cargo-dist's `release.yml` (generated by the same cargo-dist version, repository guard `rayx-ui/RayX.CLI`), `dist-workspace.toml`, `release-plz.toml`, an initial `CHANGELOG.md` header and `docs/releasing.md` for 1.0.0 (REPO-3, REPO-4); port `tests/release_config.rs`, `tests/release_policy.rs` and `tests/release_automation.rs` with expectations for this repository.

sprints.title: Host, setup engine, pins and base sets

tasks.title: Port the host layer
tasks.descriptionMarkdown: Port `src/host/` and its groups `command_runner`, `host_facts`, `path_env` unchanged in behaviour (PORT-1).

tasks.title: Port the setup engine without the GPU set
tasks.descriptionMarkdown: Port `src/setup/mod.rs`, `machine.rs` and the setup half of `records.rs` with `setup_engine` and `setup_update_prompt` (PORT-2). `Set` has no `Gpu`; `--gpu` is unknown; `--all` covers the remaining sets; add those tests to `setup_engine` (PORT-7). Leave the optional sets as stubs that plan no steps until sprint 3.

tasks.title: Port project discovery, pins and fmt
tasks.descriptionMarkdown: Port `src/project/` without the per-package dependency model, the pins table of design §7 (PORT-3), `src/fmt.rs`, and the groups `project_pins`, `pin_sources`, `fmt_command` with fixtures updated for the removed and changed pins.

tasks.title: Base sets for NSH
tasks.descriptionMarkdown: Port `setup/rust.rs` and `setup/macos.rs` with `setup_macos`; rewrite `setup/linux.rs` and `setup_linux` for NSH's packages and the distribution floor (SETS-1); adapt `setup/windows.rs` and `setup_windows` (no fxc, WebView2) (SETS-2).

tasks.title: The web set
tasks.descriptionMarkdown: Rewrite `setup/web.rs` and `setup_web` for SETS-3: no nightly, `wasm-bindgen-cli` only with a lock entry.

tasks.title: The test set
tasks.descriptionMarkdown: Port `setup/test_tools.rs` with `setup_test_tools` and `setup_node_selection`; expose the Playwright Chromium path (SETS-4).

tasks.title: The iOS set
tasks.descriptionMarkdown: Port and adapt `setup/ios.rs` and `setup_ios` (SETS-5).

tasks.title: The Android set
tasks.descriptionMarkdown: Port and adapt `setup/android.rs`, `setup_android` and `setup_android_pins` (SETS-6).

sprints.title: Guests, doctor, self update and memory

tasks.title: Port the guests
tasks.descriptionMarkdown: Port `setup/guest.rs`, `setup/wsl.rs`, `setup/lima/`, `migrate.rs`, the guest half of `records.rs`, `refresh.rs`, `remove.rs`, `setup/update.rs` and `src/wsl.rs` with their seventeen groups (PORT-4), applying the four changes the criterion lists.

tasks.title: Port doctor
tasks.descriptionMarkdown: Port `src/doctor/` with the group `doctor`, without the GPU section (PORT-5). Add to `tests/doctor.rs` the doctor halves of two ported tests that moved because `doctor` did not exist yet: `pin_sources`'s `doctor_shows_only_project_and_default_sources` (sprint 2, adapted to `android-36`) and `setup_android`'s check that doctor reports a wrong JDK and a wrong `JAVA_HOME` as `WrongVersion` (sprint 3; the probe half stays in `setup_android` as `a_wrong_jdk_and_a_wrong_java_home_report_their_versions`).

tasks.title: Port self update and releases
tasks.descriptionMarkdown: Port `src/update.rs` and `src/release.rs` with their five groups for `rayx-ui/RayX.CLI` and the 1.0.0 floor (PORT-6).

tasks.title: AgentX memory
tasks.descriptionMarkdown: Create `.agentx/memory` as REPO-5 says, carrying over the old repository's decisions that still hold (read `RayX.CLI.Old/.agentx/memory/decisions/INDEX.md` and those records), and update `AGENTS.md`'s memory line. Run the audit.

tasks.title: The fork's release workflow
tasks.descriptionMarkdown: On `fork/release` (worktree `nsh-wt/release`), add `.github/workflows/fork-release.yml` as FORK-1 and `d-fork-release` say, copying upstream's `dist` job steps from `.github/workflows/release.yml`; commit it with an NSH-style subject (`ci: Release fork-* tags with prebuilt distributions`). Change nothing else.

tasks.title: The fork docs and the sync warning
tasks.descriptionMarkdown: On `private/fork-docs` (worktree `nsh-wt/fork-docs`), update `README.md` and `scripts/sync-main.sh` as FORK-2 says, and add `scripts/tests/sync-main-release-warning.sh` (TAP, throwaway repositories under `mktemp -d`).

sprints.title: The nsh pin, store and installs

tasks.title: Resolving the pin
tasks.descriptionMarkdown: Write `src/nsh/pin.rs` and the defaults-table entries (PIN-1, PIN-2, PIN-3) with `tests/nsh_pin.rs` and lock fixtures.

tasks.title: The store and prune
tasks.descriptionMarkdown: Write `src/nsh/store.rs` (STORE-1) and prune (STORE-2) with `tests/nsh_store.rs`.

tasks.title: Installing from a release and from source
tasks.descriptionMarkdown: Write `src/nsh/install.rs` (INST-1, INST-2) with `tests/nsh_install.rs`, using recorded `Runner` commands and small archive fixtures.

tasks.title: rayx nsh, the setup step and doctor's lines
tasks.descriptionMarkdown: Add `rayx nsh status|path|install|prune` (NSHCMD-1), the base-set `nsh` step and doctor's lines (NSHCMD-2), with `tests/nsh_command.rs` and `tests/setup_nsh.rs`.

tasks.title: Real installs
tasks.descriptionMarkdown: Write the ignored group `tests/proof_nsh_install.rs` (INST-3) and run it.

tasks.title: rayx app
tasks.descriptionMarkdown: Write `src/app/` for RUN-1 with `tests/nsh_run.rs` (an `exec` seam the tests can record). Set `ANDROID_NDK_HOME` to the pinned NDK when it is unset and installed (`d-ndk`, `setup::android::pinned_ndk`).

tasks.title: The prerequisite map
tasks.descriptionMarkdown: Rewrite the old prerequisite logic for design §6.1 (RUN-2) with `tests/app_prereqs.rs`.

tasks.title: RAYX_NSH and path pins
tasks.descriptionMarkdown: Implement RUN-3 with `tests/nsh_fork_dev.rs`.

tasks.title: rayx new
tasks.descriptionMarkdown: Implement `rayx new` (NEW-1) with `tests/new_app.rs`, using a recorded `nsh init`.

tasks.title: rayx serve
tasks.descriptionMarkdown: Port Gamify's static server into `src/serve.rs` (SERVE-1) with `tests/serve.rs`.

tasks.title: An app on the web, macOS and the iOS simulator
tasks.descriptionMarkdown: Write and run `tests/proof_app_web.rs` (PROOF-1) and `tests/proof_app_apple.rs` (PROOF-2); boot a simulator first when none is booted.

tasks.title: Gamify through rayx
tasks.descriptionMarkdown: Write and run `tests/proof_gamify.rs` (PROOF-3), reading Gamify only.

tasks.title: README and project docs
tasks.descriptionMarkdown: Write `README.md`, `docs/projects.md` and `docs/manual-verification.md` (DOCS-1); port and adapt `readme_versions` and `readme_guests`; write `readme_nsh`.

sprints.title: Owner-run: fork release, other hosts and rayx 1.0.0

tasks.title: Publish the fork's first release (owner go-ahead)
tasks.descriptionMarkdown: With the owner's go-ahead: push `fork/release` and `private/fork-docs`, open and merge the fork pull request after its CI (OWN-1); dispatch `fork-release.yml` for `fork-0.2.0-4` and verify the release and a distribution install (OWN-2).

tasks.title: Linux and Windows (owner hardware)
tasks.descriptionMarkdown: Run the OWN-3 steps in a Lima guest and on the owner's Windows PC with WSL; log them in `docs/manual-verification.md`.

tasks.title: The repository and 1.0.0 (owner go-ahead)
tasks.descriptionMarkdown: With the owner's go-ahead: move `RayX.CLI.Old`'s README install links and push them, create and push `rayx-ui/RayX.CLI`, set `RELEASE_PLZ_TOKEN`, merge the 1.0.0 release pull request, and check the installer over 1.4.1 (OWN-4).
